summary: Grandpa Jerry talked about his childhood in Kladno under the chimneys of the Poldi steelworks, where his dad Frank worked at the furnace. He remembered his mum Anna and her buns and his sister Vera. With his friend Pepa Walker, who lived next door and was two years younger, he played football on the patch. He started telling how he and Pepa ran off to the fair in Prague in 1958, but saved the ending for next time.

newOpenThreads.title: Running off with Pepa to the fair in Prague
newOpenThreads.whyUnfinished: He didn't say how they got home or what happened at home.
